liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Jerry's solo in this track opened the reviewer to greater appreciation of the music [17]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): The reviewer highlights this track as another sweet performance from the 1987 season [27]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): The performance of this song is described as a perfect rendition that sealed the deal [17]
- **Quinn The Eskimo (The Mighty Quinn)** (1 review): The reviewer claims they did not hear this song, as the set ended with Turn On Your Love Light [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-10-03.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83906.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 141 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: The Miller remaster of this show is described by the reviewer as sounding incredible [24]
- **gd1987-10-03.139804.sbd.ultramatrix.pcm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 144 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1987-10-03.sbd.gmb.79380.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 139 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1987-10-03.sbd.owen.399.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 140 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: The reviewer rates the sound quality of the recording as a four-star performance [18]
- **gd1987-10-03.165069.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 144 min [6]
- **gd1987-10-03.121961.sbd.miller.sbd.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 142 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [14]. Said about its sound: The reviewer describes the soundboard recording as nice for 1987 standards and very enjoyable [27]
- **gd1987-10-03.ec7.bowen.116344.flac**: source not stated; 19 songs; 138 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [15]

## Around the show

- The taping section was located on the lawn, where sound was better due to delay towers [23]
- 1987 was the first year the Dead played Shoreline, after a previous year's cancellation [23]
- The band returned to the west coast after a long emotional year of doubt about Garcia [24]
- The encore was moved to the end of the first set to fit the show onto two discs [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-10-03.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83906.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Maxell MX90) D [1]. Also: Paul Scotton and Joani Walker supplied the tapes for this audience recording source [1]
- **gd1987-10-03.139804.sbd.ultramatrix.pcm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Recording Info: UltraMatrix SBD -> PCM; Transfer: PCM (Sony SLV-M20HF) > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (16-bit/44.1k) >… [2]. Also: David Gans supplied the PCM source, while Joani Walker and Paul Scotton provided the patch [2]
- **gd1987-10-03.sbd.gmb.79380.sbeok.flac16**: taped by DAT kindly provided for transfer by B.Koucky, rec'd from B.Fried in 1996.; transferred by Chris Ladner, Bill Koucky, Bruce Fried; source: Healy Matrix SBD > PCM > DAT (48KHz)> DAT [3]. Also: Seeded by the green mountain bros in October 2006, this is the only lossless source [3]
- **gd1987-10-03.sbd.owen.399.shnf**: transferred by Michael Owen; source: SBD>MCASS>DAT [4]
- **gd1987-10-03.165069.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Joani Walker; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 23, 2023; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell MX90) [6]. Also: Paul Scotton supplied the tapes, and multiple ultramatrix masters were used to complete the show; Joe B. Jones provided the pitch correction settings for this specific recording transfer [6]
- **gd1987-10-03.121961.sbd.miller.sbd.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Maxell MX90) [14]
- **gd1987-10-03.ec7.bowen.116344.flac**: taped by Jeff Bowen; transferred by Brad Foster; source: Source: (OTS/Lawn/Center) Superscope EC-7's (ortf/cardioids) > Sony TC-153SD; [15]. Also: The reviewer aimed EC-7 microphones at the repeaters to capture an awesome recording [23]
